subject: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 GA release, announced August 13, 2026
central_claim: DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 is a publishable AI engineering topic because official DeepSeek GA, model/pricing and API guide documents, together with the public Hugging Face repository metadata, support a bounded E2 claim: the August 13 GA turns the V4 Pro preview into an agent-oriented API/product surface, while teams must separately track version aliasing, pricing and public weight status.

selection.reason: The topic affects model/API selection, agent runtime integration, reproducibility logs and budget planning for SW engineering teams. It is a same-day GA release with official DeepSeek documentation and public Hugging Face metadata. Korean relevance is practical rather than local: teams in Korea need the KST price-change time and cost impact for hosted API workloads.
